newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwean shares active but weaker on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwean shares active but weaker on Thursday.

text.p: Zimbabwean shares were active but weaker on Thursday, reflecting continued investor bias towards the local money market, brokers said.

"What's still depressing the market is high interest rates on the local money market," one broker commented, adding this meant that particular market continued to be more attractive to investors than the bourse.

The industrial index shed 17.99 points to close at 10,024.26, weighed down by losses in agricultural firm Acacia which slipped 40 cents to 250 while timber company Border and bankers FMB both put off 100 cents to 1,450 and 4,100 respectively.

In minings, gold giant Ashanti, coal producer Wankie WNKI, and nickel firm Bindura all traded unchanged but gold producer Falgold at 70 and copper miners Mhangura at 30 were both up five cents. The seven-share index there edged up 2.96 points to 1,013.83.
